pnl_monthly.description: P&L by month and reporting line. actual from GL (period activity); budget = approved original plan, extended by Claude for months the plan does not cover; forecast = latest estimate for remaining months. Amounts are positive natural amounts; sign=+1 adds to profit, -1 deducts.

kpi_monthly.description: Company KPIs by month: orders, customers, AOV, P&L subtotals and margins, ad spend, MER, CAC, fulfillment cost, headcount and month-end balances.

balance_sheet_monthly.description: Month-end balances from the trial balance (assets positive, liabilities positive).

category_monthly.description: Product category economics recognized at warehouse dispatch: gross sales, discounts, returns (refund date), COGS from stock issues less restocks.

sku_l12m.description: SKU scorecard for last 12 months (2025-11..2026-10) with prior-12-month comparison and stock position at 2026-10-31.

channel_monthly.description: Storefront sessions, funnel and booked sales by channel group (Shopify last non-direct click).

marketing_monthly.description: Meta and Google campaign spend and platform-attributed results. Platform attribution overlaps: never add platform values to get company sales.

suppliers.description: Supplier scorecard: PO volume, on-time arrival vs original ETA, open payment commitments, advances.

cash_forecast_items.description: 13-week cash forecast line items from 2026-11-01 to 2027-01-30. Negative = cash out. kind: Known (document/contract), Estimated (driver-based), Policy (discretionary).

product_pnl_monthly.description: Fully allocated P&L by month and SKU (adds up to the ledger). Direct: sales, discounts, returns, COGS, write-offs. Allocated: shipping income, fees, fulfillment, storage, returns handling, ads (by campaign-attributed order lines), overhead (two bases: _rev = share of net revenue, _lines = share of order lines).

allocation_rules.description: How each P&L cost pool is assigned to SKUs.

rows.driver: Shopify order lines shipped in the month (dispatch date)
Refund lines by SKU on refund date
Shipping charged per shipped order, split to lines by net value
Weighted-average landed cost of units dispatched, less accepted restocks
3PL damage and cycle-count adjustments by SKU
Actual processor fee per order, split to lines by net value
Actual 3PL pick/pack + label cost per order, split to lines by shipped weight
Month-end units on hand x unit weight (space proxy)
Returned units received by the 3PL in the month
Each campaign's monthly spend split by the order lines it brought in (Shopify last non-direct click); campaigns with no orders by sales mix
Selectable: share of net revenue, or share of order lines (handling effort)
Share of net revenue (only for net profit)

campaign_roas_monthly.description: Campaign performance by month: platform-reported conversions/value (Meta 7d click 1d view, Google data-driven; these overlap) vs storefront last-click orders and revenue from utm_campaign_id; POAS = attributed contribution after fulfillment / spend.

marketing_efficiency_monthly.description: Company marketing efficiency by month: spend, MER, break-even ROAS (net revenue / contribution before marketing), platform ROAS, storefront ROAS, POAS, CAC.
